statement: In L_d=Q(beta_d), beta_d^(3^d)=53*zeta3, a literal nine-column residue matrix proves the completed L2 ordinary-unit basis. All ordinary L2 units are field norms from L3. The entire ordinary three-class groups are D2=C9^2+C3 and D3=C27+C9+C3, with actual norm, extension, prime and S-quotient maps. The three-prime has orders3 and9. At every later level the norm is onto, its kernel lies in the fixed prime subgroup with exponent3, and both trace compositions equal3. Compatible class groups have type C_(3^(a_d+1))+C9+C3; the actual Kato restriction gives finite h=sup a_d>=2. The ordinary-unit norm quotient is C3^(3-a_(d+1)+a_d), its completed kernel mu3+Z3^(2*3^d), and the coherent three-valuation image exactly3^h Z3. Literal product coordinates, inverses and total norm refine E123's full positional factor.
where_proved: sections/E_fiftythree_ordinary_valuation.tex, complete proof and E124.1--24; nine final replayed mathematical stages, complete finite-map enumeration and both complete decoded PARI objects.

notes: The embedded subgroup N(E_(d+1)) is retained with its Hilbert90 map; no higher unit basis or numerical row is invented. The finite h is not numerically evaluated. This does not close full E23 or assert intrinsic lifting from H. No upper BNF or regulator assumption is used. Exact ambient rational Smith entries include modulus-one rows and decoder assertions.
